desc: Fix stale segment-tree ancestor min/max values after point assignments and validate the Cartesian-tree recurrence.
Derive a rigorous characterization of when a starting slime can expand across an interval, including strict inequality and absorption order.
Prove correctness, especially for newly unlocked sides and strict equality cases.
Verify complexity and implementation safety for \(N\le 5\times10^5\), including recursion depth and 64-bit sums.
Produce the final stdin/stdout Python solution enclosed in the requested code delimiters.
